reason: The baseline showed valid cross-instance mutations hidden from detail/page reads and deleted data remaining visible. Reloading the persisted catalog before reads fixes the real execution path, corrupt persistence fails explicitly, the independent HTTP check observes 201/200/200/404 as expected, and the clean .venv suite passes (3020 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed). The originally registered update/delete contention hypothesis is retained as a negative result and deferred; this is mechanism acceptance, not accuracy promotion.

next_hypothesis.claim: Corrupt or unavailable component-preset persistence should return a dedicated catalog error envelope instead of the generic scenario_error 422 path.
